info.title: API.SH: AutoScout24
info.description: The AutoScout24 API from API.SH: public AutoScout24 data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An AutoScout24 dealer: id, name, address, phones, fax, website, about text, imprint, opening hours by department and day, services, logo and photo, rating, rating and review counts, recommend share and the latest reviews (stars, date, first name, text, the five grades, dealer reply); plus the dealer's cars, 20 a page (id, link, make, model, version, body type, price, net price and VAT, price rating, first registration, mileage, power, fuel, transmission, offer type, previous owners, consumption, CO2, electric range, images) and the makes it has in stock. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/autoscout24-dealer

Pass `next_page` back as `page`. `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/autoscout24-listings

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An AutoScout24 /lst search URL. Or give make/model and filters.

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: Make as in AutoScout24 URLs (e.g. bmw, mercedes-benz).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Seller countries, comma-separated: D, A, B, E, F, I, L, NL (default D).

parameters.name: fuel
parameters.description: petrol, diesel, electric, hybrid, plugin_hybrid, lpg, cng, hydrogen, ethanol, other (comma-separated).

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: compact, convertible, coupe, suv, station_wagon, sedan, van, transporter, other.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: standard, price_asc, price_desc, mileage_asc, mileage_desc, year_desc, year_asc, newest, power_desc.

get.description:
AutoScout24's car taxonomy: every make with its id and slug (top makes flagged), or with `make` that make's models (id, name, slug, model line, and a ready /autoscout24/v1/listings link), model groups and model lines. Use the slugs as `make` and `model` in /autoscout24/v1/listings.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/autoscout24-makes

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: A make name or slug (e.g. bmw, mercedes-benz). Leave out to list every make.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
